description: Atoms' and ions' k-distributions per 1 nm cell (rendering plan R08, R08.T4.e; decision-r08-t4ef-storage; decision-r08-t4e-budget), written by apps/hyperion/scripts/atmosphereData.mjs atomic-k-distributions-merge from the fetched lists named here, which are not committed. The cells are in the binary parts listed, little-endian: HYKD, u16 version, cells, variants, temperatures, pressures and 0; then per cell u16 nm, u16 G, f64 ln sigma (m2 a molecule) of code 1, f64 its step, G f64 weights, and u16 codes over variants x temperaturesK x pressuresPa x g, g fastest, code 0 for sigma 0, else ln sigma = offset + step (code - 1). pressuresPa are air-equivalent broadening pressures; a two-variant table's values are mixed at fixed g by the self share of the Lorentz width. A cell of G = 1 is stored as its mean (decision-r08-t4d-kdist-chain.md section 9). For these tables pressuresPa are H2-equivalent, the pressure of pure H2 that gives the lines their van der Waals widths at the node's temperature, and the broadening ratios are each gas's width over H2's, a gas not listed taken as H2, estimated. Reduced values; the citations are in NOTICE's Data section.
source: R. L. Kurucz's line list gf1100.all (Na I; R. L. Kurucz, "Including all the lines", Can. J. Phys. 89 (2011) 417, DOI 10.1139/p10-104); P. S. Barklem and R. Collet, Astron. Astrophys. 588 (2016) A96 (CDS J/A+A/588/A96, tables 4, 7 and 8); P. S. Barklem, N. Piskunov and B. J. O'Mara, Astron. Astrophys. Suppl. Ser. 142 (2000) 467 (CDS J/A+AS/142/467); Na D's impact widths by H2 from N. F. Allard, F. Spiegelman, T. Leininger and P. Molliere, Astron. Astrophys. 628 (2019) A120 (CDS J/A+A/628/A120)

terms: R. L. Kurucz states no terms for his line lists: reduced values with their citation, the lists not committed (decision-r08-licences.md; decision-r08-cmf-licence.md section 7.3). Barklem and Collet 2016's and Barklem, Piskunov and O'Mara 2000's tables are CDS's (VizieR: free of usage in a scientific context; A&A-origin tables free for a scientific usage), read 2026-10-19, and only derived values are committed; Allard et al.'s tables are CDS's too (J/A+A/628/A120, read 2026-10-19; the deposit's README states none), read as data, the deposit's readers not run
reduction: Each 1 nm vacuum cell's absorption line by line at each node (Voigt profiles, Humlicek 1982): every line of the stage's list over 360-780 nm by vacuum wavelength from a level below its ionisation limit, its strength in LTE per absorber of the stage (Boltzmann populations with Barklem and Collet 2016's partition functions, stimulated emission counted, no Saha factor: the column is the stage's own), its Doppler width thermal, its Lorentz width radiative (Kurucz's Gamma_rad, else the classical) plus van der Waals at the node's pressure of pure H2 (Barklem, Piskunov and O'Mara 2000's ABO width per H atom where their table holds the line, else Kurucz's own, each taken to H2 by Unsold's scaling, C6 proportional to the perturber's polarisability, else Unsold's per perturber, a neutral atom's from an upper level of n* 6 or more and at least 0.1 from an integer bounded by the high-Rydberg width 2 v N (sigma_pol + sigma_F), Alekseev and Sobel'man 1966 and Omont 1977, decision-r08-t4e-unsold); cut off 25 cm-1 from each line's centre at every pressure (Na D's and K's far wings beyond it are their pairs' cross-sections), nodes whose cell's intensity-weighted Lorentz half-width passes 0.25 cm-1 estimated; sorted into its k-distribution and reduced to two-point Gauss-Legendre g-intervals shared by every node of the cell, by bisection to 8e-4 in T over every column to 400 p_eff / (m g) at g = 0.5 m s-2 and helium's Rayleigh column; temperature nodes on the stage's ladder (E1, decision-r08-t4ef-storage section 5.3, or E1', decision-r08-t4e-budget section 3) from its visibility floor, refined by bisection to a quarter of E1's step where the chain test (cubic in T on ln sigma, the client's rows at the standard pressures each read between the table's nodes, the read cubic in ln p on tau) fails 2e-3; alternate pressure nodes below 1 MPa dropped where it passes (E3), and an 8-a-decade midpoint added between two held rows below 1 MPa where it fails by the read itself (decision-r08-t4e-unsold's follow-up); ln sigma stored in 16 bits a value (decision-r08-t4d-kdist.md; decision-r08-t4d-kdist-chain.md). Na D's van der Waals widths by H2 are Allard et al. 2019's ab initio impact half widths (their tables' headers at 1e21 cm-3 over 500-3000 K, ln w linear in ln T, and a power law beyond to 5000 K), by He and the air gases scaled from them by Unsold's rule, by H the lines' ABO widths; their impact shifts are left out (under 0.13 cm-1 at 1e19 cm-3).
